title: CommuteTour Philippines route directory
summary: Directory of Philippine commute route pages, terminals, bus operators, and fare notices. Use for route discovery and to identify which terminals or modes may be relevant.
caution: Fares and schedules may change without prior notice; riders should verify with operators or terminals.

title: Pasay Rotonda / MRT Taft terminal routes
summary: Pasay Rotonda has terminal services near MRT-3 Taft Avenue / LRT-1 EDSA for Cavite-bound trips and connections through PITX or MOA.
caution: Confirm the exact bay, vehicle type, signboard, fare, and operating status before boarding.

title: Operational UV Express routes and fares
summary: Lists UV Express terminal pairs around Metro Manila and nearby provinces, including Paranaque-Ayala, Sucat-Lawton, Marikina-Cubao, Novaliches-Cubao, SM North-Fairview, and Antipolo-Ayala.
caution: Published fares are old and should not be treated as current. Use route pairs only and ask riders to verify present fares.

title: One Ayala Terminal guide
summary: One Ayala Terminal supports city bus, EDSA Carousel, P2P, and UV Express services to destinations including PITX, Alabang, Bicutan, Paranaque, Antipolo, and Las Pinas.
caution: Schedules and boarding gates can change; verify inside One Ayala before riding.

title: PinoyCommute Philippines public transport guide
summary: Public transport guide for routes, terminals, fares, schedules, and station or terminal locations across the Philippines, including Metro Manila transport modes.
caution: Use as supporting route and terminal guidance; confirm current fare, distance, and operating status before riding.

title: How To Get There Philippines community
summary: Community Q&A subreddit for Philippine commute directions. Useful for uncommon routes, recent commuter experiences, and routes not covered by formal guides.
caution: Community answers are unofficial and may be outdated, incomplete, or location-specific. Use only as a fallback and verify with terminals, operators, or official sources.
